_note: Everything is built procedurally from primitives, Terrain, Beams, Trails, ParticleEmitters and UI instances: no marketplace assets, no uploads except the generated audio (existing pipeline). Names are the Instance names / module keys the implementer must use.

naming.decor: client-only: workspace.SparkDecor/<arenaId>/... (built on arena entry, destroyed on exit)

materials.ground: Terrain (Grass / Sand / Sandstone / Snow / Glacier / Water) generated at server start from arena JSON; fallback (flag WORLD_PARTS_ONLY): SmoothPlastic slabs + WedgeParts
materials.props: SmoothPlastic default; Neon only for <= 40 emissive accents per arena; Glass for crystals/lantern; Foil for golden variant; NO Sandstone/Slate/Grass part materials on props (noisy at arcade scale)
materials.castShadow: true only on landmarks, creatures' body part and players; false on everything smaller than 3 studs

featureBuilders.recipe: tapered 3-segment trunk (cylinders, slight lean), 4 heart-shaped leaf lobes (2 spheres + wedge each) per canopy tier x2 tiers, 12 hanging glow buds, falling-leaf ParticleEmitter (rate 2)
tapered tower of 4 stacked cylinders, conical cap, door, 4 sails (frame + pastel cloth) on a HingeConstraint-free CFrame spin (client-animated)
cliff notch, 3 stacked translucent Neon-teal sheets with scrolling Texture, splash ParticleEmitter, mist
brass base, 6-pane Glass column, inner Neon flame mesh of 3 twisting spheres, PointLight range 40; colour driven by round phase
cylinder drum, hemisphere of 8 wedge-gores, roof slit, brass rings, telescope
Terrain Water in a 2-stud basin, ringed by 10-14 pebbles and 6 lily pads
Terrain Water channel 6 wide, 1.5 deep along the polyline, reeds every ~12 studs (client decor)
one Glacier-coloured SmoothPlastic disc/ellipse approximated by a MeshPart-free 24-gon of wedges OR Terrain Glacier; Reflectance 0.25
5 mushrooms: stem cylinder + squashed sphere cap (alternating accent colours) with white dots; cap squashes 30% on bounce
dry-stone wall: rounded blocks 2-3 studs with jitter, 5 high, mossy cap strip
client decor: 60 grass blade clumps (2-part) at seeded positions; LOD: none beyond 90 studs
bulb of 6 petal wedges closed around a Neon core; open state rotates petals 70 degrees outward
tall stem, 5-petal disc, Neon centre that glows as the landing telegraph
3-4 intersecting rounded blocks, banded colour, flat-ish top
12-gon of banded blocks with a flat grass/sand top disc
banded sandstone/ice blocks with 0-1 stud depth jitter; teal or pink seam strip at mid height
bottle-cap ring (crimped cylinder), dark vent, bubble ParticleEmitter; eruption = 30-stud Beam column + spray emitter for 1.2s
Terrain Sand patch with 8 ripple decals (client)
low sand dome; bulge animation = scale 1.0 -> 1.5 over the telegraph
striped rounded column with 2 arms and a gumdrop flower
flat round stone with a Neon ring that lights while occupied
3 leaning Glass prisms (wedge pairs) + Neon core, base snow mound
inlaid Neon star in the ice
half-log with bark ends, moss patches
5 flat stones across the creek
existing RecordsBoard, restyled; adds the line 'Legend in N rounds'
upright torus-like ring of 12 segments, 10 studs inner diameter, standing on two short posts; slow rotating inner sparkle; flares on bank

creatureModels.rule: client-built from data/models/*.json part lists (Meadow authored; Canyon and Aurora authored in WP-10/12 from 03 and the silhouette sheet); <= silhouette.parts parts; one invisible anchored Root + welded visual parts; face kit = two glossy ink eyes; near-detail parts (glints, cheeks) only for the 8 nearest creatures within 35 studs; animated by Root:PivotTo, SpecialMesh.Scale/Offset and Weld.C0, never by Humanoid or Motor6D

vfx.impl: 2 Trails per player sharing two foot Attachments 1.2 apart (FaceCamera=false, LightEmission 0.6, texture ribbon_trail.png): a TRAVEL trail and a LOOP trail, so the loop can be cleared at closure without erasing the travel tail. Local ribbon: opaque head fading to 30% tail; other players 50%
1 Beam from head to the snappable ribbon point, dashed texture, shown inside 2x snapRadius
pooled ring of 24 Beam segments that tween from the loop polygon to its centroid over cinchSeconds
per creature: 1 ParticleEmitter burst (12 particles, species colour) + the creature model itself flies an arc into the parade (no extra parts)
pooled BillboardGui at the loop centroid: big score, tech tags beneath; rises 4 studs over 1.2s
character Trail (existing cosmetic) + 6-particle dust puff at start + 2 speed-line Beams for the dash duration
parade creatures arc through the ring one by one (0.05s stagger) + ring flare + 20-particle burst
1-4 flat Neon rings stacked over a multi-wrap creature; fill = wraps landed
pooled flat ring/chevron parts for geyser, starfall, hop, charge line, stampede route chevrons
Beam strip along the lane polyline with scrolling chevron texture + sparse particles

vfxBudgetCheck.note: sum of budgetParts above must be <= 80 (validator enforces)

textures.status: generated, NOT uploaded: no Roblox asset ids exist. Owner uploads via Asset Manager; ids go in R/Design/Slice (WP-07). Every use has an untextured fallback (slice.json visualCues)
